rationale: Verified the official registry API for the completed acute Zanthoxylum armatum extract trial and the planned chronic extract trial. Both retain unpublished registered fatigue outcomes in healthy gamers. Whole ground culinary exposure and a Parkinson fatigue result remain open.

NCT07630571 remains completed without results. Its title describes a single-arm pilot, while the structured design lists randomized parallel comparisons. The grapeseed comparator contains C60 and its processing grade is unreported. No isolated cold-pressed grapeseed-oil pain result is available.

The completed SPISAR registry specifies force-platform balance as a secondary endpoint. The registry, original strength paper and thesis give no comparative force-platform outcome suitable for the claim. The trial uses spinach extract and the frozen claim uses steamed spinach.

NCT04677946 remains not yet recruiting without results. Its high-linoleic cookie does not name the oil. Related NCT04677920 names grapeseed oil in a different protocol. Cookie oil identity and the original extract trial full insomnia comparison remain unavailable.

The Bian original journal abstract remains verified at abstract depth only. Direct raw versus dry-fried comparison and voucher remain unverified. The completed NCT07562672 topical postoperative mixture trial has no published registry results and no isolated oral culinary comparison.
